name: hover-card
title: Hover card
description: Preview extra content when a link or element is hovered or focused.
a11y: Opens on pointer hover and on keyboard focus of the trigger.
Supplementary only: never put the sole path to information or actions in it.
Not shown on touch devices; the trigger must work on its own.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Milliseconds the pointer must rest on the trigger before the card opens. Default 700.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before the card closes after the pointer leaves the trigger and the card. Default 300.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts of the component: a trigger and its content.

usage:
import {HoverCard, HoverCardContent, HoverCardTrigger} from '@monoline/react'; @adaAda Lovelace
